_readme: Path Finder knowledge base. Every record has a source_type and confidence. 'general-knowledge' records are NOT verified facts: the app labels them 'general guidance - verify'. Add or correct records here; the agent will only ever state what is in this file, in your uploaded documents, or in cited web results.

regulators.name: Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (PMDC)
regulators.check: Before applying, confirm the college is PMDC-recognised and that your intake year is approved.

regulators.name: Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC)
regulators.check: Confirm the engineering program is PEC-accredited: only accredited degrees lead to PEC registration.

regulators.name: Higher Education Commission (HEC)
regulators.check: Confirm the university/campus is HEC-recognised for the exact program (check the recognised-institutions list on hec.gov.pk).

regulators.name: Pharmacy Council of Pakistan
regulators.check: Confirm the Pharm-D program is recognised by the Pharmacy Council of Pakistan (search its official website).

regulators.name: National Computing Education Accreditation Council (NCEAC)
regulators.check: Check whether the computing program is NCEAC-accredited (search the council's official website).

regulators.name: National Business Education Accreditation Council (NBEAC)
regulators.check: Check whether the business program is NBEAC-accredited (search the council's official website).

programs.name: MBBS

rules.text: Minimum 55% in the entry test for MBBS
Minimum 60% in FSc Pre-Medical for NUMS

programs.notes: Public-college seats are decided by aggregate merit; see the Merit Calculator for past closing merits.

scholarships.name: HEC Need Based Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Higher Education Commission (via participating public-sector universities)

rules.text: Monthly family income from all sources not exceeding Rs. 45,000 (figure quoted by a university page: HEC may have changed it, verify)

requirements: Admitted on merit at a participating public-sector university
Self-finance, evening and distance-learning students are not eligible
Students holding another scholarship or grant are not eligible
You do not apply to HEC directly: apply through your university's financial aid office
Reported stipend: Rs. 6,000 per month (verify current amount)

sources.title: Women University Multan - HEC Need Based Scholarship criteria (income limit, stipend, attendance)
HEC Need Based Scholarship - eligibility and award process (university page quoting HEC)
HEC Need Based Scholarship downloads page

careers.title: Medicine / Dentistry
steps: Complete MBBS or BDS at a PMDC-recognised college
Complete the mandatory house job / internship and register with PMDC (verify current rules)
Choose a direction: clinical specialisation, public health, research or teaching

careers.title: Engineering
steps: Choose a direction: industry, research (MS/PhD), or entrepreneurship

careers.title: Computing and data
steps: Complete a BS in a computing field (check NCEAC accreditation)
Build projects and an internship record while studying
Choose a direction: software, data/AI, security, or postgraduate study

careers.title: Pharmacy
steps: Register as required by the Pharmacy Council (verify current rules)
Choose a direction: hospital/clinical, industry, regulatory work, or research

careers.title: Business and finance
steps: Gain internships and, if relevant, professional certifications
Choose a direction: corporate, entrepreneurship, finance, or postgraduate study
